verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gate overrides that let specific users bypass a gate or be forced into a variant for testing/QA. A tutorial also shows targeting internal testers, so per-user inclusion (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts) is directly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding specific individual users from a flag, in-depth docs on override/allowlist mechanics (e.g. ID lists, limits), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: set up Feature Gate overrides to allow specific users to bypass the gate.
set overrides to force specific users into a variant for testing or QA.
This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers
